top_risks.rationale: forget_permits CAS now preserves the CLOSED bit when writing back permits; previously the shift-left would clobber CLOSED, silently re-opening a closed semaphore.
top_risks.subject: tokio/src/sync/batch_semaphore.rs:forget_permits

evidence_refs:
match self.permits.compare_exchange_weak(
                curr_bits,
-                new << Self::PERMIT_SHIFT,
+                (new << Self::PERMIT_SHIFT) | (curr_bits & Self::CLOSED),
top_risks.rationale: CLOSED bit read from curr_bits inside the CAS loop; relies on compare_exchange_weak to retry if another thread sets CLOSED between load and CAS, which it does via Err(actual).
